App details

Fraction Calculator

Calculate with fractions and mixed numbers, and follow the steps to the answer.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

Add, subtract, multiply, divide and simplify fractions and mixed numbers, with step-by-step working and fraction–decimal conversion.

Main features

  • Add, subtract, multiply, divide and simplify.
  • Convert between fractions and decimals.
  • Show percentages and repeating decimals.
  • Fractional-inch helper for practical measurements.

This app is being planned and is not yet available to download. The description presents its intended functions.

Features in detail

Fractions, explanations and workshop notation

Four operations and simplification

Enter integers, fractions or mixed numbers and choose +, −, × or ÷. The result is an exact fraction in simplest form. A zero denominator or division by zero is rejected, rather than giving a misleading result.

Mixed numbers and improper fractions

Convert between mixed and improper forms: 2 1/3 = 7/3. A negative sign applies to the whole mixed number, so −2 1/3 = −7/3. Both result forms represent the same exact value.

Decimals, percentages and repeating digits

Convert a finite decimal to a fraction, such as 0.125 = 1/8, or view a fraction as decimal and percentage: 3/4 = 0.75 = 75%. Repeating digits are marked with local mathematical notation; a shortened rounded value is clearly labelled approximate.

Steps, common denominators and reduction

Inspect the arithmetic explanation to see common denominators, adjusted numerators and simplification. The least common multiple helps find a denominator; the greatest common divisor explains reduction. Multiplication and division show the fraction operation and its simplified result.

Reciprocal, comparison and copying

Find a nonzero fraction’s reciprocal by swapping numerator and denominator. Compare two fractions exactly to see which is larger or whether they are equal. Copy the displayed result for notes; calculations do not build a saved history.

Fractional inches

Enter decimal inches and choose a denominator resolution, such as 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32 or 1/64. See the nearest workshop fraction with a rounding warning when approximate. This is for fractional-inch notation, not general length-unit conversion.

Endless halving

Tap the About logo seven times for a visual sequence: 1 → 1/2 → 1/4 → 1/8, becoming smaller but still not zero. Close the offline surprise without changing calculations or settings.

Use, settings and availability

Offline use

The main functions are designed to work on your device without a JN86 account. Ads, purchases and external links may need internet.

Language, settings and help

Choose one of eight app languages and adjust the available settings. About provides privacy information and a link to voluntary JN86 support. Support does not unlock paid functions. Availability is shown below.

Ads and optional ad removal

All described functions are planned to be free, with banner ads and optional one-time Google Play ad removal. No subscription is planned. The purchase screen shows the actual local price; purchase restoration uses Google Play.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
